content.text: /ext:medcp How many children under 18 have an asthma diagnosis in our system?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) = 'asthma'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, vocabulary_id
LIMIT 20;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) = 'asthma'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, vocabulary_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS children_under_18_with_asthma
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
JOIN omop.person p
  ON p.person_id = co.person_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009
  AND DATEADD(year, 18, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, ISNULL(p.month_of_birth, 1), ISNULL(p.day_of_birth, 1))) > CAST(GETDATE() AS date);

There are **39,398 children under 18** with an asthma diagnosis in the OMOP clinical records.

I counted distinct patients with a condition under the standard SNOMED asthma concept (`317009`) and age <18 as of today (`2026-07-22`).
